rooms.name: Hunters Guild Hall
rooms.description: The bustling headquarters where hunters gather before raids. Wooden notice boards overflow with dungeon postings. Hunters brag loudly while sharpening weapons. The air reeks of mana and ambition.

rooms.name: Tutorial Dungeon Entrance
rooms.description: A damp stone stairwell descends into shadow. Strange markings crawl across the walls, pulsing faint blue. The air is heavy — almost warning you not to enter.

rooms.name: Dungeon Lobby
rooms.description: A circular chamber lined with glowing crystals. Adventurers use this as a staging ground. The silence beyond the sealed doors chills the bones.

rooms.name: Statue Chamber
rooms.description: Gigantic godlike statues loom in eternal judgment. Their stone eyes follow your every move. The silence here is suffocating, broken only by the distant scrape of stone.

rooms.name: Ruined City Street
rooms.description: Shattered skyscrapers pierce the sky like jagged teeth. Cars lie rusting, abandoned mid-flight from disaster. Shadows dart across broken glass.

rooms.name: Double Dungeon Altar
rooms.description: A massive altar engraved with runes. Dried blood stains the floor. The rules of survival are etched in stone: "Worship the gods."

rooms.name: Gate Plaza
rooms.description: A glowing rift shimmers in the air. Hunters mill nervously nearby, checking gear before stepping into the unknown. Beyond the light is chaos.

rooms.name: Cursed Statue Throne
rooms.description: A towering statue sits upon a throne, holding a severed head. Its gaze demands obedience. The air hums with divine hostility.

rooms.name: Orc Encampment
rooms.description: Fires burn in cracked barrels. The stench of roasted meat and unwashed bodies fills the night. Orcs snarl and argue, their crude weapons gleaming.

rooms.name: Fire Chamber
rooms.description: A cavern of lava rivers and scorched stone. Pyros towers here, molten cracks glowing across his armor. He hurls fireballs at stepping stones, summons geysers, and turns the air into firestorms. Weakness: water. Hint: "Only the endless flow quenches the flame..."

rooms.name: Water Cavern
rooms.description: A shimmering cave of coral and flooding chambers. Neressa rises, cloaked in flowing water. She raises currents, drowning traps, and watery clones. Weakness: earth. Hint: "Stone alone withstands the tide..."

rooms.name: Earth Fortress
rooms.description: A titanic stone hall with shifting walls. Gravemaw stomps, creating earthquakes and stone spikes while boulders crash overhead. Weakness: wind. Hint: "Only the wind wears away the mountain..."

rooms.name: Air Spire
rooms.description: A tower of sky bridges and roaring winds. Zephyra floats above, summoning cyclones and lightning strikes, pushing hunters into the void. Weakness: fire. Hint: "Flames rise to consume the sky once more..."

rooms.name: Demon Castle Foyer
rooms.description: Immense gates open into a crimson-lit hall. Demonic runes glow on towering pillars. Every step feels like blasphemy.

rooms.name: Demon Castle Library
rooms.description: Thousands of cursed tomes float mid-air, pages turning by themselves. Whispers seep into your mind, urging you to read forbidden knowledge.

rooms.name: Demon Castle Throne Room
rooms.description: A long red carpet leads to a massive black throne. Claws have shredded the walls. Demonic energy radiates like a heartbeat.

rooms.name: Monarch's Chamber
rooms.description: The oppressive presence of a Monarch fills the room. Cracks of black lightning scorch the marble floor. The air vibrates with raw dominion.

rooms.name: Dimensional Rift
rooms.description: A swirling vortex of space and time. Gravity bends oddly here. Your reflection flickers in the void, smiling back differently.

rooms.name: Hunters Association Office
rooms.description: Suits and uniforms bustle about, papers stacked high. Giant holographic maps of gates flicker overhead. This is the heart of strategy.

rooms.name: Eternal Battlefield
rooms.description: Swords and shields from countless ages litter the field. Spirits of warriors wander aimlessly, reliving endless war.

rooms.name: Hospital Ward
rooms.description: Rows of hunters lie unconscious. Nurses rush between beds, mana stones glowing faintly in medical equipment. A sense of fragility lingers.

rooms.name: Hunter Exam Arena
rooms.description: Stone coliseum seats tower overhead. Spectators roar as new hunters prove themselves. Mana signatures burst like fireworks in the air.

rooms.name: Dungeon Boss Chamber
rooms.description: Bones crunch underfoot. A monstrous roar echoes. The boss lurks just beyond the shadows, its breath shaking the walls.

rooms.name: Shadow Army Plains
rooms.description: Rolling plains stretch endlessly. A black mist rises from the soil. The whispers of fallen shadows gather around you, waiting for command.

rooms.name: High Orc Fortress
rooms.description: Heavy wooden gates bar the path. Drums thunder inside, announcing your arrival. The stench of sweat and iron fills the air.

rooms.name: Hunters' Cafeteria
rooms.description: A surprisingly normal room. Hunters chat over coffee and ramen. Laughter briefly masks the dread of their next raid.

rooms.name: Blacksmith's Forge
rooms.description: Sparks fly as weapons are reforged. The smell of molten metal and mana crystals fusing fills the room. Each strike resonates with power.

rooms.name: Monarch's Throne
rooms.description: The throne of destruction towers, larger than life. The Monarch of Shadows gazes upon the battlefield with infinite weight.

rooms.name: Monarch's Throne of Darkness
rooms.description: Darkness itself gathers like liquid. The shadows bow to you here. Every whisper feels like a promise of more power.

rooms.name: Final Gate
rooms.description: A colossal rift glowing brighter than the sun. Beyond it lies the endgame — the fate of hunters, Monarchs, and the world itself.
